scope: One existing candidate: exact mIGF article/exposure and model/functional audit, practical clinical comparator update, patent/product/capture review and marginal-dollar decision.

selection.objective: Expected discounted financial value retained by ddiscov after the remaining costs, rights payments, sharing and financing required for a useful product.
selection.selected_uncertainty: Whether exact mIGF-Gel can offer useful epithelial repair or a practical reduction in total treatment burden over a credible topical-insulin product, with a feasible exposure/product and retained-value route.
selection.basis: Next eligible bounded information sprint after the published APR, RM, BLU and NDC source passes; one existing candidate, no replacement candidate clearly favored by this update.

delta.finding: Exact primary audit narrows the acute and steroid-suppressed evidence, biological units, treatment timing and material-control interpretation.
delta.decision_effect: Retain a functional preclinical rationale without asserting delayed rescue of chronic human disease.

delta.finding: Tracer retention, aqueous-humor pharmacokinetics, nominal assembled concentration and released active exposure are different measurements.
delta.decision_effect: Keep the article, formulation and relevant exposure as one product question; no numerical correction or delivery failure inferred.

delta.finding: Additional persistent-defect insulin evidence includes an uncontrolled multicenter cohort and a comparative historical-control study, with specific formulations and outcome/follow-up limits.
delta.decision_effect: Use a credible practical active comparator; do not infer an unbiased rate, equivalence or direct gel inferiority.

delta.finding: Insulin sensory observations are mixed and emerging comparator trials are not results.
delta.decision_effect: Do not reserve a nerve claim to mIGF by assuming the comparator has no sensory potential, or replace current evidence with future trial plans.

delta.finding: Older patent prose explicitly discloses the sequence, while its granted sequence listing differs; the newer corneal application expressly names the product/use.
delta.decision_effect: This is an existing disclosure and potential rights-dependent contribution; do not infer exact granted coverage, freedom to operate, ownership or license availability.

delta.finding: A stable physical gel and a low nominal dosing frequency do not establish a sterile, potent, usable ophthalmic product or an executable budget.
delta.decision_effect: Recompare actual useful information and remaining product/rights costs; preserve the original assumption without automatic rank inheritance or spend.

retrieval_stop.completed_information_sprint: mIGF exact-product, functional/model, comparator and rights/product audit with a bounded marginal-dollar decision
reopen_for: Specific exact-product functional or relevant exposure data that change the intended claim or feasibility.
Substantive missing primary methods/data that resolve a decision-changing denominator, timing, comparator or product question.
A relevant controlled comparator outcome or a credible exact-product, rights, access, supply or scoped-cost fact that changes the next commitment.

activity_boundary: Published-document research, deterministic content checks and repository publication only. No outreach, purchases, recruitment, experiments, simulations or material receipt.
interpretation_limits: No exact-mIGF human result or direct insulin-comparator efficacy result recovered.
Supplement, detailed animal/eye allocation, exact administered exposure and delayed-start qualification remain limited.
Tracer retention and aqueous PK are not intact epithelial target exposure.
Insulin clinical evidence has population, product, confounding and follow-up limits; no pooled causal rate.
Original Arg/Ala discrepancy, present title, global rights and commercial terms remain unresolved.
Actual sterile product, costs, access and retained economic contribution remain unqualified.
Preliminary qualification does not inherit the original useful comparator information value or rank.
